paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Grepgui Tungthu Gentehna
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, sing dang sang in gammang nuai a sing lak a grepgui bang ahi tuam a le?
english: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

paite: Thil bawlna dia asing zat ahi hia? Tui-um belsuan khaina ding in kua'n azang ngei a le?
english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

paite: Ngai in, mei a paihlut ahi a, toh ding in mei in akangmang, among langnih, akang khin a alai ah phattuamna anei a hia?
english: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?

paite: Ngai in, abit lai nangawn in aphatuam kei; akatmang khit nung in, phatuam sin kei na tel e!"
english: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamnuai sing lak a grep guite, toh ding in mei ah ka khul maimah bang in, Jerusalem luah mite ka bawl ding.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Amau ka masuan ding a, pawt mah le uh, mei a kipan, akangbei ding, mei in, TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh; amaute ka masuan hun chiang in.
english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.

paite: Agam uh ka hihgawp ngei ding ahi, thulimlouhna ahih ziak un chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord Yahweh.
